messages:
alexa: Opening intake — Acme Corp reported intermittent high tail latency on embeddings (nightly batch jobs). Problem: p99 spikes causing downstream timeouts for their analytics pipeline. Need to capture problem statement, goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan. TL;DR: customer wants p99 < 300ms under their batch profile; they may buy dedicated capacity if required.
ajay: Can you share the batch profile (sizes, items/request, qps, payload) so eng can estimate?
alexa: Here's the sample from the customer (sanitized):
```
batch_size: 128
avg_items_per_request: 50
embedding_dim: 1536
qps_peak: 2
window: nightly 02:00-04:00
payload: text arrays ~5KB per item
```
maria: Proposed goals: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 300ms for their nightly workload on hosted offering. Non-goals: model architecture changes, support for unbounded batch sizes, or changing global SLAs for other tenants. Acceptance idea: a reproducible staging run + 2-week canary passing metrics.
samir: Edge cases to call out: cold-starts (batch landing when instance pool spins up), large single requests (>10k items), cache/KV pressure on long sequences, intermittent network egress throttling. Need tracing + per-tenant breakdown.
ajay: Engineering asks: reproducible workload script + representative dataset + any customer-side retries/timeout policies. Also: are they hitting timeouts client-side or server-side? logs would help.
alexa: I'll request logs and a sample dataset. For repro, use this quick load command (internal): `./loadgen --model ada-emb --batch 128 --items 50 --qps 2 --duration 3600` — tweak to match payload sizes.
qa-bot: Acceptance checklist draft:
- synthetic load reproduces nightly profile in staging
- p99 < 300ms sustained for at least 1 hour under target load
- error rate < 0.5% (5xx + timeouts)
- automated regression test added to perf suite
- canary rollout to 5% of tenant traffic with automated rollback on SLO breach
- runbook updated with troubleshooting steps and escalation
- billing note updated if Dedicated capacity required
:heavy_check_mark:
maria: +1 on checklist. Product: need prioritization (P0/P1) and a PM to own contract amendment risk. Also add as non-goal: no SLA expansion for other customers without exec sign-off.
samir: Rough estimate: 3 sprint-weeks to implement infra + batching/cache tuning + instrumentation, then 1 sprint for QA and staging validation. If we leverage existing prefix caching and batching heuristics, could shave time.
ajay: Rollout gating proposal: require passing staging perf AND a single-tenant dedicated run that meets p99 target for 24h. If we can’t meet target, fallback plan is to throttle tenant batch_size or move them to a dedicated pool. Document fallback thresholds (e.g., reduce batch_size to 64 then 32).
deploy-bot: I'll create feature flag `acme_large_batch_v1` and a canary route. Will open PR for rollout automation and healthcheck hooks.
alexa: Great — I'll author the PRD intake doc with problem statement, proposed goals/non-goals, acceptance checklist above, edge cases, and rollout plan. I'll also ask legal about contract amendment for dedicated pricing. Product: please assign priority and a PM.
maria: Assigned PM suggestion: @maria to PM until handoff. Product to confirm prioritization by EOD Friday.
ajay: One more note — add metric capture for KV cache hit rate and cold-start count to the perf dashboard so we can correlate spikes.
alexa: Noted. I'll include dashboards and exact query strings in the PRD. Thanks everyone — tagging for follow-ups :@maria @ajay :thumbsup:
